0.original: Agujam is worried by what lurks beneath the sands.

24.original: Slay any diremites that appear in the rocky area to the west.

48.original: Do these foul creatures not rest!?

49.original: Ah, you there, adventurer. Should you be willing, I would like your help with something.

50.original: I have sighted an unusually large number of diremites in the area of late. They always appear after sandstorms. This would not be a problem if they fought fairly. However, they choose to cower beneath the sands, waiting to strike when you are vulnerable.

51.original: Slay any that you find by the rocky area to the west and I shall see you are rewarded suitably. You have my word.

52.original: Slay any that you find by the rocky area to the west and I shall see you are rewarded suitably. You have my word.

53.original: The beasts have been slain? You have my thanks.

54.original: If the diremites only attacked warriors such as ourselves, this would not have been such a problem. But they will prey on anyone. Women, children, it matters not to them.

55.original: I will not stand for this. We must not rest until they have been eradicated from the area.

56.original: Thank you for helping me to dispatch the first few of them. We will take care of the rest.
